component.name: Papaya
component.summary: Autonomous ARM Steam & ROM Gaming Runtime

description.p: Papaya is a next-generation compatibility runtime and ROM translation layer designed to run Windows Steam games and console optical disc images (ISO/CSO/CHD) on ARM handhelds, SBCs, and Linux devices.

ul.li: Potato Mode 1x1 Texture Stripping & Mipmap LOD Bias Clamping
Forced 540p Resolution Downscale with Spatial FSR Upscaling
Linux 6.14+ NTSync Kernel Primitives & io_uring DirectStorage I/O
Decoupled Steamworks DRM with Goldberg Stub & Save Vault Sync
